selection_rule: Highest unweighted mean of A→B, B→A and walk-forward Log R²; ties by model name. No candidate deploys unless all three Log R² values are strictly positive.

evaluation.outer_split: sum of slug character codes mod 2: A=0, B=1
evaluation.inner_validation: sum((character_index+1)*character_code) mod 5 = 0, applied only inside each training partition
evaluation.ridge_objective: sum squared log errors + lambda*sum(beta_j^2), intercept unpenalized
evaluation.normalization: population mean/std fitted on that training partition only; category vocabulary from training only
evaluation.ridge_selection: Minimum inner-validation log MSE; lower lambda breaks exact ties; refit on all outer-training rows.
evaluation.selection_caveat: Outer scores select among eight candidates; they are not a fresh unbiased test of the selected candidate.
evaluation.walk_forward_caveat: Listing chronology is not historical snapshot backtesting: all covariates and labels are observed as of the same sealed snapshot.
